decisions.reason: Because the product closely builds on the firm's existing earmold and hearing-system knowledge, its absorptive capacity allows it to interpret early results and improve the offer, so dropping is unlikely.
As a custom in-ear earmold that leverages established competencies and in-house R&D, the firm can assimilate market feedback and refine it, making discontinuation unlikely.

Given the firm's digital production know-how and certified manufacturing processes, this thermoforming unit is close to existing capabilities, enabling learning and improvement rather than withdrawal.
